items.why: Volatility is spiking as stocks swoon on AI fears and investors rush to Treasuries, with the sell-off continuing on worries about AI, tariffs, and inflation.
Nvidia is leading the slide as the AI-fueled rout continues and the Nasdaq pares losses after a sharp drop.
AMD is caught in the same AI-driven sell-off, with headlines warning an AI bust could hit harder than the dot-com crash.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures down 0.94% and Nasdaq futures down 1.95% as the AI-fueled rout continues.
summary: Stocks are sliding in a tech-led sell-off as AI fears keep hitting chip names and the broader tape. The Nasdaq is down sharply and volatility is spiking as investors rush to safety.
